headline: Approved minutes from March 2026 meetings; no motor vehicle appeals were heard.
summary: No appellants showed up for motor vehicle assessment appeals during the meeting. The Board approved the minutes from the March 10 and March 11, 2026 meetings. Members also discussed state rules limiting appeals to manufacturer's suggested retail price disputes and talked about getting appeal applications electronically before the March meetings.
decisions: Approved the minutes for the March 10 and March 11, 2026 meetings, motion by Emilia Menna-Erdmann, seconded by Thomas Vitali, passed unanimously.
